crystal.d: [[t:832438339|Michigan]] has the edge, 83 points up on [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. Michigan grades out an A+ in conference prestige, which happens to be his dealbreaker.
crystal.call: Barring a late swing, this one's done.

crystal.name: L. Laury
crystal.d: [[t:832438293|Clemson]] has controlled this one, sitting 234 points clear of [[t:832438383|Tennessee]]. Clemson grades out a B+ in championship contender, which happens to be his dealbreaker.
crystal.call: Book it.

crystal.name: D. Way
crystal.d: [[t:832438308|Florida]] leads on paper, 69 to 60, but [[t:832438288|BYU]] checks more of his boxes. BYU grades out an A- in conference prestige, which happens to be his dealbreaker.
crystal.call: Gut call: BYU. Nobody should be comfortable.

crystal.name: C. Crouse
crystal.d: [[t:832438274|Alabama]] has built a real cushion: 194 points to Ohio State's 103. Alabama grades out an A in championship contender, which happens to be his dealbreaker.
crystal.call: Barring a late swing, this one's done.

crystal.name: J. Ledyard
crystal.d: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] has built a real cushion: 167 points to Florida's 68. Notre Dame is the home-state school, and proximity to home is his dealbreaker.
crystal.call: Book it.

notes.d: [[t:832438394|UCLA]], [[t:832438383|Tennessee]], [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]], [[t:832438337|Miami]] and [[t:832438284|Boise State]] are all but in.

cfp.method: Every remaining regular-season game is simulated 4,000 times from team ratings and scoring margin (home field worth about 2.5 points). Conference title games pit the top two in each league. A committee-style ranking weighs wins, losses, strength of schedule, conference titles and the current poll. The field is the five highest-ranked conference champions plus the next seven, with byes for the top four seeds.
